title: Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says
lede: Per the Wall Street Journal, Huang belittled Colette Kress in a summer finance meeting and doubted she could help him with strategy, before she replaced him as interim CEO.

points: The remark came in a meeting on plans to guarantee billions of dollars for data center operators that could not pay for chips upfront.
Kress reportedly questioned credit-based deals involving Huang's son-in-law Nico Caprez, asking how to value guarantees and judge returns.
She scaled back Nvidia's commitment to OpenAI's Ohio data center to $105 billion, from talks of $250 billion in credit.
Huang resigned Thursday after reports of affairs, and Nvidia is searching for a permanent CEO.
